parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:
- If this is the first request or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
- If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: PrefixListIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the prefix lists to query. Valid values of **N**: **1** to **100**. You can query up to 100 prefix lists at a time.

parameters.name: PrefixListName
parameters.description:
The name of the prefix list to query.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region in which to query prefix lists.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the prefix list belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
